notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-return-immediate (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): PCIMMA's four modes (RETURN IMMEDIATE, LINK with and without a COMMAREA, START) and the PCIMML it links. Each scenario is one task. The case is entered as a LINKed program (linked: true), as the pc-return-channel case is. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: link-commarea
scenarios.why: mode L: LINK PCIMML with a COMMAREA and SYNCONRETURN; PCIMML rewrites the text

scenarios.name: link-no-commarea
scenarios.why: mode N: LINK PCIMML with none; its RETURN IMMEDIATE is below the highest logical level

scenarios.name: start
scenarios.why: mode S: START PC54 INTERVAL(0), a task with no terminal

scenarios.name: no-mode
scenarios.why: a mode no WHEN names: RETURN
